title: 2.5.22 When Does finally Run?
description: Build a try/catch/finally and confirm finally runs in both the success and the failure case. Auto-graded.
sourceRef: designed — practice for 2.5.5 Concepts in Practice 'When finally runs'

steps.title: Predict first
steps.instructions: In a comment, predict which blocks run when the try block succeeds: try and catch, try and finally, or all three.

steps.title: Build the success case
steps.instructions: Write a try block that logs "Work done." with no error. Give it a catch block that logs "Handling error." and a finally block that logs "Cleanup ran."

steps.title: Confirm
steps.instructions: Run it. Confirm catch was skipped but finally still ran.

requirements.title: try/catch/finally present
requirements.description: Code has a try, catch, and finally block

requirements.title: try block cannot fail
requirements.description: The try block logs Work done. with nothing that can error

requirements.title: finally logs cleanup
requirements.description: The finally block logs Cleanup ran.
